description.value: You can speak clearly with creation itself. You gain @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.Speak with Animals], @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.Speak with Plants], and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.Speak with Computers] as 4th-rank primal innate spells, and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.Speak with Stones] as a 5th-rank primal innate spell. You can cast one of these spells once per day.
